about: Boann's Lake Delhi 2010 baseline for boann_gate.py: the observed breach (as_observed.json) at the case's 30 m cell, run with the CPU build of the GPU kernels (bit-identical to one core; GPU == CPU is metal-engine.yml's gate). Differences are model minus surveyed over the 8 USGS high-water marks below the dam (OFR 2011-1301 table 8). Recorded 2026-11-22 from DWR_Plugins main 3f536222 (Runner 3.42.0) in the cloud. Re-record when an accuracy change is meant to move these numbers, and say so in the PR.
